ModMetaData.name: Show Translation Keys
ModMetaData.author: YourName
ModMetaData.description:
A debug tool for translators. Replaces translated text with the raw translation key, so you can visually map each key to its UI location.
Key wrapping requires Dev mode. Spawn/UI helpers can be decoupled from dev mode via a checkbox in the settings.
Features: - Wraps every translated string with the raw key, using <<key>> markers - Highlights target keys with >>key<< markers - Detects and reopens the UI that used a key (stack trace + configurable hotkey) - Context generator: spawn a pawn/item/creature with a specific Def - Art/tale support: spawns sculptures with a random tale and lets you reroll it - UI catalog: scan and open any Window/MainTabWindow in the running game - Prefix filter, wrapper style, fully localized settings UI - Silent UTF-8 encoding check on startup (warns in the log if translations were saved with the wrong encoding)
Requires Harmony. This is a debug-only tool — the game becomes unreadable on purpose while key wrapping is on.
